newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: RESEARCH ALERT - Argentina's Disco initiated as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Argentina's Disco initiated as buy.

text.p: -- Santander Investment said Monday it initiated Argentine supermarket chain Disco with a "buy" recommendation.

-- "Disco's aggressive expansion plan, together with its strategy to compete with the hypermarket chains, makes its stock an atractive vehicle to take advantage of the Argentine recovery and the growing participation of supermarkets and hypermarkets in the distribution of food products in the domestic market," analyst Arturo Torres said in a report under the title "Dance the Disco Beat".
-- "We expect 18 percent sales growth over the next three to five years, mostly driven by the expansion of selling space".

-- "Our 12-to-18-month target price is $32 per ADR, 24.3 percent above the current level." That yield would be way above the Buenos Aires Stock Exchange blue chip index MerVal's expected gain over the the same period, Torres said.
